reviews.text: There are two veterinarians in the clinic, a man and a woman. Both are friendly and helpful, although professionally speaking. Since my dog ​​is being treated by him, I can only comment on Dr. Grasso's expertise. He's approachable, professional, and competent. Reasonable prices and a clean environment.

I couldn't have asked for anything better for my little dog, followed by Dr. Grasso. He's always available, answers calls and messages even after hours, and treated an ulcer in one of his eyes without ever charging him. My old man has been receiving injections for a month now, without ever charging him. He's a true doctor who cares about the health of our furry children. The doctor is also always available, kind, and ready to see him when he wasn't there. Thank you!

Criminals is an understatement! I found them online and took my cat in for a checkup for a large cyst. The extraction was complicated, and the result came back null. The report clearly stated that I needed a new test. When they realized I wouldn't pay another 80 euros for a failed extraction that I wasn't responsible for, the doctor decided to send me home, saying everything was fine, and to continue with a medication they'd given me 10 days earlier, which didn't help at all, despite my concerns. Obviously, I went elsewhere to avoid the risk of the cat having cancer. I paid half the price, including a second attempt in the event of a null result (as is right), but the first one was fine! Instead, they sent me home with the risk that the cyst was cancerous without analyzing it, all to avoid having to pay 30 euros for the lab! Speechless, worthy of a lawsuit!! Absolutely avoid!

Both doctors are exceptional people, as well as excellent veterinarians.

They have been our go-to people for our dogs for 13 years. Very attentive and meticulous, they allowed one of our dogs, who is no longer with us, to live a perfect life despite a series of illnesses.

The same thing happened with my in-laws' dog. It seemed like he only had a few months left, but instead they managed to give him almost two more years of life in dignified conditions.

I will always have words of affection and gratitude for them for all they do for our furry friends.

Thank you.
Knowledgeable, kind, helpful, and honest veterinarians. Dr. Grasso is our primary care physician for Alex (a Labrador) and our two cats, ages 11 and 8. He always takes care of them.
Dr. Grasso and Dr. Greco, always professional and available.

In my opinion, the doctor is much better and more attentive. Dr. Grasso, with whom I had met several times for my cat's visits, left me quite perplexed. He hadn't noticed the infection in his teeth, and his thyroid tests were altered. He told me to leave him as he was, since he had no symptoms. His eyes were watering profusely, which he underestimated and didn't even notice. After a few days, my cat closed one eye. Since they don't have an ophthalmologist, I was forced to look for another veterinary clinic. IT WAS THE LIFESAVE!!! A door closed, but a door opened. I'm sorry to say it. . . . . .but that's how it is. . . .👎
Always courteous and professional. A point of reference. Thank you!

My cats have been cared for by Dr. Grasso since he opened his practice in Torresina. Sometimes in his absence, they have been examined by Dr. Greco, and I personally have nothing but praise for both their expertise and the empathy they show towards animals. I definitely recommend them to all pet owners!
Empathetic, helpful, professional, honest. Given my limited experience, I don't think I could have found anyone better. Dr. Greco and Dr. Grasso are exceptional.
